notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Optical improvements
Performance improvements

Different doors in different maps
Improvements of the ingame energy level
More possibilities of interaction

notes.title: Update V 1.3
notes.notes:
Update V 1.3

General
In the lobby when switching between menu and play mode, the chat history is no longer deleted.
Statistics - bugs fixed.
Swedish inserted. (other languages will follow)
Escape Route 3 is now available.

Player

 A new character "Tatjana".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39061373/c544a4b2c26d7e216415e9a71db767b0db56b479.png
 Everyone can now help everyone without a first aid kit. But there are only 1000 points instead of 2000.


Maps

 Hotel Marble - bugs fixed.
 Hotel New Overlook - bugs fixed.

notes.title: Release V1.0
notes.notes:
Version 1.0 is now released! There is a new map, a new monster and a new level of environmental interaction. 

Welcome to Spencer Mansion 2
